requirements.text: Approximately 4–15 years of professional software engineering experience. Technical depth, trajectory, and what you have actually built matter more than years alone.
Demonstrated 0-to-1 experience taking a product, platform, or major technical capability from an idea through production.
Strong hands-on development experience across backend, frontend, or full-stack engineering, with Python, React, and TypeScript particularly relevant to the current environment.
Experience building sophisticated production software, including SaaS platforms, enterprise applications, distributed systems, developer platforms, or similarly complex products.
Experience in a startup, early-stage, growth-stage, or other high-ownership engineering environment.
Exposure to AI/ML, LLMs, intelligent agents, or AI-enabled application development is highly valuable, particularly where those capabilities have made it into production.
Cybersecurity, offensive security, red-team tooling, security automation, or adjacent experience is valuable but not required.
Excellent computer science fundamentals with the ability to reason through architecture, systems design, algorithms, data structures, performance, and engineering tradeoffs.

Strong academic foundation in computer science, computer engineering, or a closely related technical discipline. Candidates from rigorous engineering and computer science programs are particularly relevant.
Strong communication skills. You can explain technical decisions, defend your thinking, absorb feedback, and collaborate with other highly technical people.
A builder mentality. You are intellectually curious, technically ambitious, comfortable with ambiguity, and energized by problems where the answer has not already been written down.

The current environment includes Python on the backend, React on the frontend, TypeScript across the application layer, and AI/LLM technologies powering increasingly sophisticated product capabilities.
